python3 << 'EOF'
from funcy import rcurry, get_spec

def f3(a, b=10):
    return a + b

spec = get_spec(f3)
print(f"spec = {spec}")  # ({'a'}, 1, 2) - only 1 required arg
_, n, _ = spec
print(f"n = {n}")

# So @rcurry will NOT curry f3 since n=1

@rcurry
def f3_dec(a, b=10):
    return a + b
    
print(f"\nf3_dec(1) = {f3_dec(1)}")  # Returns 11 directly
print(f"f3_dec(1, 20) = {f3_dec(1, 20)}")  # Returns 21
EOF

```python

    return func
```
